response.sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS standing_count FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(standing_count) AS avg_count FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS average_points, AVG(p.standing_count) AS average_count, AVG(p.standing_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess_count FROM per_name AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.standing_count > o.avg_count;
